title: A Dynamical Theory of the Electromagnetic Field — Abstract
version: Proceedings of the Royal Society of London 13 (1864), pp. 531–536; original abstract received 27 October and read 8 December. Archive scan independently reopened for this proposal.
lineage: Contemporary author’s account of evidence used in his theory. It supports a documented intellectual contribution, not modern endorsement of the mechanical medium or unique derivation of all field equations.

passages.locator: pp. 531–532 / PDF pp. 1–2, paragraph across page break
passages.note: Read Maxwell’s explicit use of magnetic polarization rotation as indication of motion in a medium, followed by attribution of the motion argument to W. Thomson.
